title: The Civic Alignment Program
description:
Four papers, three seed-pinned verification batteries, and a Lean 4 formalization of the core theorems on AI deployment and collective epistemic capacity: pressure, drift, capture -- and a pre-registered audit protocol to locate deployments on the ladder. Every quantitative claim in the papers has a named, asserted witness in a battery; the formal results of Papers I-III are machine-checked against Mathlib with no axioms beyond Lean's standard three.

Licensing is path-specific; see LICENSES.md in the archive. The Python batteries and general repository documentation are MIT; the Lean formalization (lean/) is Apache-2.0; the manuscripts, bibliographies, rendered papers, and rendered paper figures are Copyright (c) 2026 Daniel Hofheinz, all rights reserved.
